_comment: The Codex #274 heartbeat is the named semantic-validation and re-entry caller. A timeout is an incident, never permission to publish or deliver unvalidated bytes.
_note_reentry: The caller publishes an explicit semantic verdict, verifies Portal deployment/receipt, then invokes drain. The read-only retrieval consumer itself still has no dispatch authority.
_note_no_fail_open: UNVALIDATED_TIMEOUT and UNVALIDATED_NO_VALIDATOR are historical audit statuses only and are not deliverable under briefing_finalization/18.
